summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by China Pharma Holdings, Inc. for an offering of 2,500,000 shares of common stock at $2.00 per share under a Securities Purchase Agreement dated July 22, 2026. The shares trade on NYSE American under CPHI, with a recent close of $8.10. The filing details risks related to the PRC operating environment but does not describe an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown.
